mapper.select: SELECT distinct FINPROD_ABBR AS finprodAbbr /**资产全称(金融产品简称)**/ FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE PROFIT_TYPE in ('01','03') and FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
mapper.insert: insert into FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION (FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE, PUBLISH_DATE, VAL_DATE,VALUATION,INPUT_TYPE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) values (#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{finprodType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{publishDate,jdbcType=DATE}, to_date(#{valueDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), #{valueAsset,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, '01', #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: SELECT a.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, /**资产代码(金融产品代码)**/ a.VAL_DATE AS valueDate /**估值日期**/ FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION a WHERE a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and a.VAL_DATE = to_date(#{valueDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
SELECT a.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId /**资产代码(金融产品代码)**/ FROM FIN_PRODUCT a WHERE a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT a.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, /**资产代码(金融产品代码)**/ b.FINPROD_ABBR AS finprodAbbr, /**资产全称(金融产品简称)**/ a.INPUT_TYPE AS inputType, /**录入方式**/ a.VAL_DATE AS valueDate, /**估值日期**/ a.VALUATION AS valueAsset /**资产净值**/ FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION a left JOIN FIN_PRODUCT b ON a.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID and a.FINPROD_TYPE = b.FINPROD_TYPE WHERE b.PROFIT_TYPE in ('01','03') and a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.VAL_DATE = to_date(#{valueDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd')
mapper.update: update FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION set VALUATION= #{valueAsset}, UPDATE_USER = #{updateUser}, UPDATE_TIME = sysdate where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and FINPROD_TYPE='F17' and VAL_DATE= to_date(#{valueDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
mapper.delete: delete from FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and VAL_DATE = to_date(#{valueDate} ,'yyyy-MM-dd') and FINPROD_TYPE= 'F17'
